notes: Protocol-level mapping, not a per-vendor guarantee. Measured deviations the shared pipe (lib/stream) absorbs: all three vendored adapters declare toolCallShape 'fragmented' and reuse the wire's own fragment ordinals (first fragment carries index/id/name with empty arguments; later fragments carry the argument slice only, id and name null/absent); reasoning arrives as delta.reasoning_content, and OpenCode renames it through its own alias list (vendor/opencode/lib/upstream-map.js REASONING_FIELDS) because some routes publish a different field name. EXAONE reports usage.reasoning_tokens at the TOP level instead of completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens, so its adapter projects the value before the one shared usage writer runs; DeepInfra adds usage.estimated_cost. The usage-bearing chunk can carry choices: [] (measured on DeepInfra), so usage must never be read only when a delta is present. Cache is reported as usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens and must be split out of prompt_tokens. structuredOutput is the protocol's capability (response_format), NOT something the current router exercises: no vendored adapter sends response_format today. content_filter maps to a failure code (CONTENT_FILTERED), never to a clean stop.
